title: adw-baja-blast
label: El Triton
how: Won the vacant title in a three-way (with El Professor and Rory Borealis) after the 6-way tag match's own winning team — El Professor pinning The Void — set up the contendership; The Void interfered, pulling El Triton over El Professor for the pin. Successfully defended against Gavin Firebrand at Run for the Border (stakes: the title and El Triton's own kidnapped son) — still champion at the record's own last word.
note: El Professor and The Void fought to a Steel Cage draw the same night for the #1 contendership, then rematched at Run for the Border (El Professor won, first out of the collapsing cage) — no challenger match against El Triton for the title itself has occurred within the surviving record.
